newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK DEPOS SOFT, FORWARDS FLAT, ECU/DRS AROUND 309.
newsitem.headline: GREEK DEPOS SOFT, FORWARDS FLAT, ECU/DRS AROUND 309.

text.p: Greek depos were softer and forex forwards were holding late Thursday levels, bonds were idling and ecu/drachma was hovering around 309 in early quiet trade, dealers said.
Greek markets were closed on Friday and Monday for Orthodox Easter.
"Ecu/drachma is hovering around 309 in early trading," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank.

"Some players have opened large long mark/drachma positions around 158.00/50," said Panos Panayiotopoulos, assistant treasurer at Alpha Credit Bank. "These guys not just pay the points but also suffer forex losses with a softer ecu/drachma and a firmer ecu/mark."
Panayiotopoulos added that he expected stop losses to be hit later this week if mark/drachma broke the 158 level on the downside.
"These positions will hit stop losses if mark/drachma heads below 158," he said. "I expect ecu/mark to firm after the British elections on Thursday."
The U.S dollar was advancing against the drachma, currently trading around 274.25/35 after hitting 275 earlier on, dealers said.
"Depos are softer and forex forwards are holding low Thursday levels," said a money market dealer at a private bank.
The mark was quoted at 158.25/35 from Thursday's 158.770 fix, the dollar at 274.09/19 drachmas from 272.900 and the ecu at 309.01/11 from 309.180 drachmas.
